title: MCP tools

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask mcp-tools-docs`; do not edit. -->

`fauxfield mcp` selects classes with `--allow read,write,execute` (default all; `--read-only` is `--allow read`). A tool outside the allowed classes is not listed and is refused with a protocol error. Results never contain secret values.

## Tools

| Tool | Class | Read-only | Destructive | Idempotent | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `clear_dataset` | execute | no | yes | yes | Empty a Dataset's live rows (runtime only; the seed file is untouched and `reset_state` restores the rows from it). |
| `disconnect_ws_client` | execute | no | yes | yes | Close one WebSocket connection with a close code. |
| `refire_callback` | execute | no | no | no | Fire the Callbacks (webhooks) of a recorded request again, now, and return the outgoing entries with their status and error. |
| `reset_state` | execute | no | yes | yes | Reset state: Datasets back to their seed (persisted state deleted), response counters, sequence cursors and runtime variables. Scope with `server` and optionally `dataset`; omit both to reset the whole workspace. |
| `restart_server` | execute | no | no | no | Restart a Server (stop, then start). |
| `send_test_request` | execute | no | no | no | Send one HTTP request to a running Server over loopback and return the response and the Dataset changes its actions made. |
| `send_ws_message` | execute | no | no | no | Send a message to one WebSocket connection, or to every connection of a Route or Server. |
| `set_chaos` | execute | no | no | yes | Turn the chaos switch on or off (runtime only): with a rate above 0 that fraction of requests gets a random fault (reset, close, empty, malformed or 500). |
| `set_network_profile` | execute | no | no | yes | Read or set the workspace network profile (runtime only, not written to files): none, fast-3g, slow-3g, flaky-wifi or offline. A profile overrides every Server's [network]; offline refuses connections. |
| `start_server` | execute | no | no | no | Start a Server, or every enabled Server when `server` is omitted. Binds loopback unless the server file says otherwise. |
| `stop_server` | execute | no | no | yes | Stop a Server, or every Server when `server` is omitted. |
| `certs_status` | read | yes | no | yes | Development CA status: path, fingerprint, expiry and whether this machine trusts it. Never changes a trust store. |
| `certs_trust_command` | read | yes | no | yes | The exact platform command that trusts the development CA. It is only returned, never run: ask the user to run it. |
| `dataset_references` | read | yes | no | yes | Everything that uses a Dataset: CRUD Routes, free-text `data.<name>` uses, seed files and persisted state. |
| `get_openapi` | read | yes | no | yes | The generated OpenAPI 3.1 document of a Server, built from its files (works while stopped). The document is capped at 64 KB; `truncated: true` means it was left out, so use `fauxfield docs spec` for the whole document. |
| `get_route` | read | yes | no | yes | A Route with its Responses. |
| `get_server` | read | yes | no | yes | Full Server including folders and routes. Secret-looking variables are redacted. |
| `get_traffic` | read | yes | no | yes | Recent recorded requests (newest last) with the route that matched, status and timing. Secret headers are masked. |
| `list_routes` | read | yes | no | yes | List Routes, optionally of one Server. |
| `list_servers` | read | yes | no | yes | List Servers. |
| `list_static_files` | read | yes | no | yes | Files a `static` Route serves (path under its dir, size, MIME type, whether it is a Tera template). |
| `list_ws_connections` | read | yes | no | yes | List live WebSocket connections of a Server and the message timeline (in/out frames). |
| `match_path` | read | yes | no | yes | Which Route a request would match: the winner, all candidates (best first) and closest hints. |
| `ping` | read | yes | no | yes | Check that the Fauxfield MCP server is alive. Returns {"ok": true}. |
| `preview_generator` | read | yes | no | yes | Sample values for a Dataset seed generator definition (int, uuid, regex, one_of, fake, ...). Touches no Dataset; `ref` generators are not available here. |
| `render_template` | read | yes | no | yes | Render a Tera template string, or a Route's Response, against a sample request (no server needs to run). Returns status, headers, body, render time and any error. |
| `server_info` | read | yes | no | yes | Version, schema version, active transports, allowed tool classes and build features. |
| `validate` | read | yes | no | yes | Validate the workspace; returns structured diagnostics. |
| `workspace_info` | read | yes | no | yes | Workspace manifest, environments, servers and a validation summary. |
| `bake_dataset` | write | no | no | yes | Generate a Dataset's rows from its generator and write them to data/<name>.json as the static seed (the generator block is replaced). |
| `create_server` | write | no | no | no | Create a Server (writes servers/<slug>.toml). |
| `delete_dataset` | write | no | yes | yes | Delete a Dataset. Blocked while Routes or templates reference it unless `force`; the seed file and persisted state are removed only with remove_seed / remove_state. |
| `delete_route` | write | no | yes | yes | Delete a Route. |
| `delete_server` | write | no | yes | yes | Delete a Server and its file. |
| `import_dataset` | write | no | no | yes | Import a JSON, CSV or Parquet file into a Dataset's static seed (data/<name>.json). One-time conversion; the file is not referenced afterwards. Returns row count, inferred columns, key and warnings (ragged rows, duplicate keys, unparseable cells). Rows above the hard limit are refused. |
| `set_variable` | write | no | no | yes | Set or remove a variable at a scope (global, environment, server, route). Values for secret-looking names (*token*, *secret*, *password*, *key*) are never echoed back. |
| `update_server` | write | no | no | yes | Update Server fields (name, port, host, enabled, prefix, unmatched_hint, fake_seed), the `proxy` settings and the `docs_site` settings (published API documentation). |
| `update_workspace` | write | no | no | yes | Rename the workspace (the `name` in fauxfield.toml; comments and key order are kept). |
| `upsert_dataset` | write | no | no | yes | Create or replace a Dataset (seed file plus [[datasets]] entry). Without crud_path no Route is written (`route` is null); with it a CRUD Route is added when none serves the Dataset. |
| `upsert_route` | write | no | no | yes | Create or update a Route and its Responses in one call (also `proxy` and `pinned` flags). |

## Arguments

### `clear_dataset`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `dataset` | yes | Dataset name. |
| `server` | yes | Server ID, name or file slug. |

### `disconnect_ws_client`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | no | Close code (default 1000). |
| `connection` | yes | Connection ID (`wsc_...`). |
| `server` | yes | Server ID, name or file slug. |

### `refire_callback`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `callback` | no | Callback id; omit to fire every Callback of that Response. |
| `recording` | yes | Recording id of the request that triggered the Callback (or of one of its callback entries). |
| `server` | yes | Server ID, name or file slug. |

### `reset_state`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `dataset` | no | Only this Dataset (needs `server`). |
| `server` | no | Server ID, name or file slug. Omit to reset every Server. |

### `restart_server`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `server` | yes | Server ID, name, or file slug. |

### `send_test_request`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `body` | no |  |
| `headers` | no |  |
| `method` | no | HTTP method (default GET). |
| `path` | yes | Path and query as the client would send it, including the Server prefix. |
| `server` | yes | Server ID, name, or file slug. It must be running. |

### `send_ws_message`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `binary` | no | Send as a binary frame (body is base64). |
| `body` | yes | Message body (text, or base64 when `binary`). |
| `connection` | no | One connection ID (`wsc_...`). Omit to send to all. |
| `route` | no | Route ID: send to every connection of this Route. Omit for every connection. |
| `server` | yes | Server ID, name or file slug. |

### `set_chaos`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `rate` | no | Fault rate 0 to 1 to turn chaos on; 0 or omitted turns it off. |
| `server` | no | Server ID, name or file slug. Omit for every Server. |

### `set_network_profile`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `profile` | no | `none`, `fast-3g`, `slow-3g`, `flaky-wifi` or `offline`. Omit to read the current profile. |

### `start_server`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `server` | no | Server ID, name, or file slug. Omit to act on every enabled Server. |

### `stop_server`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `server` | no | Server ID, name, or file slug. Omit to act on every enabled Server. |

### `certs_status`

No arguments.

### `certs_trust_command`

No arguments.

### `dataset_references`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | yes | Dataset name. |
| `server` | yes | Server ID, name or file slug. |

### `get_openapi`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `server` | yes | Server ID, name or file slug. |

### `get_route`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `route` | yes | Route ID (`rte_…`). |

### `get_server`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `server` | yes | Server ID (`srv_…`), name, or file slug. |

### `get_traffic`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `limit` | no | Most recent N entries (default 50, max 1000). |
| `route` | no | Route ID, or `unmatched`. |
| `server` | no |  |
| `since_seconds` | no | Only requests from the last N seconds. |
| `status` | no | Status such as `404` or a class like `5xx`. |

### `list_routes`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `server` | no | Only this Server (ID, name, or file slug). |

### `list_servers`

No arguments.

### `list_static_files`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `route` | yes | Route ID (`rte_…`) of a `static` Route. |

### `list_ws_connections`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `after` | no | Also return timeline frames with an id greater than this (0 returns the whole timeline). |
| `route` | no | Only this WebSocket Route ID. |
| `server` | yes | Server ID, name or file slug. |

### `match_path`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `method` | yes |  |
| `path` | yes | Request path (with the Server prefix), query ignored. |
| `server` | yes | Server ID, name, or file slug. |

### `ping`

No arguments.

### `preview_generator`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `count` | no | Number of sample values (default 5, max 1000). |
| `generator` | yes | One generator definition, e.g. `{"kind": "int", "min": 1, "max": 9}` (see the generators reference). |
| `seed` | no | Seed for deterministic output (default: random). |

### `render_template`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `body` | no | Sample request body. |
| `datasets` | no | Sample Dataset state for `data.<name>`: an object of Dataset name to rows (M10.06). |
| `headers` | no | Sample request headers. |
| `method` | no | Sample request method (default: the Route's method). |
| `response` | no | Response ID; default: the Route's default or first Response. |
| `route` | no | Route ID (`rte_…`) whose Response is rendered. |
| `seed` | no | Override the Server's `fake_seed` for this render. |
| `server` | no | Server (ID, name or slug) providing variables and `fake_seed` when no `route` is given. |
| `template` | no | A raw template string to render instead of a Response (needs `route` or `server` for context). |
| `url` | no | Sample request path and query (default: the Route path). |

### `server_info`

No arguments.

### `validate`

No arguments.

### `workspace_info`

No arguments.

### `bake_dataset`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | yes | Dataset name (must have a generator). |
| `rows` | no | Row count override. |
| `seed` | no | Seed for deterministic output (default: the Server `fake_seed`). |
| `server` | yes | Server ID, name or file slug. |

### `create_server`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | yes |  |
| `port` | yes |  |

### `delete_dataset`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `force` | no | Delete even while Routes or templates still reference the Dataset (they are left as is). |
| `name` | yes | Dataset name. |
| `remove_seed` | no | Also delete the seed file. |
| `remove_state` | no | Also delete the persisted state under .fauxfield/state/. |
| `server` | yes | Server ID, name or file slug. |

### `delete_route`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `route` | yes | Route ID (`rte_…`). |

### `delete_server`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `server` | yes | Server ID (`srv_…`), name, or file slug. |

### `import_dataset`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `append` | no | Add to the existing seed rows instead of replacing them. |
| `column_types` | no | CSV column type overrides, name to `int`, `float`, `bool` or `string`. |
| `decimal_as` | no | Parquet decimals as `number` (default) or `string`. |
| `delimiter` | no | CSV delimiter, one character (default: detected). |
| `dry_run` | no | Validate and report without writing. |
| `file` | yes | Path of the JSON, CSV or Parquet file to import. |
| `format` | no | `json`, `csv` or `parquet` (default: from the extension). |
| `key` | no | Key column (default `id` when present). |
| `name` | yes | Dataset name (created when missing). |
| `server` | yes | Server ID, name or file slug. |

### `set_variable`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | yes | Variable name. |
| `owner` | no | Environment name, Server ID or Route ID (not needed for `global`). |
| `scope` | yes | `global`, `environment`, `server` or `route`. |
| `value` | no | New value; omit or null to remove the variable. |

### `update_server`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `clear_seed` | no | Remove the seed (output becomes random). |
| `docs` | no | Markdown docs of the Server (the API documentation intro). Empty removes it. |
| `docs_site` | no | Published API documentation (`[docs_site]`, SPEC §12.4); only the given keys change. |
| `enabled` | no |  |
| `fake_seed` | no | Seed for fake data and random template functions; 0 or omitted keeps it, `clear_seed` removes it. |
| `host` | no |  |
| `name` | no |  |
| `port` | no |  |
| `prefix` | no | Must start with `/` and not end with `/`; an empty string removes the prefix. |
| `proxy` | no | Proxy settings (`[proxy]`, SPEC §7.1); only the given keys change. |
| `server` | yes | Server ID (`srv_…`), name, or file slug. |
| `unmatched_hint` | no | Add the closest-routes hint to 404 bodies (default true). |

### `update_workspace`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | yes | New workspace name (1 to 80 characters). The folder on disk is not renamed. |

### `upsert_dataset`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `columns` | no | Declared columns `[{name, type}]` (types: string, int, float, bool, datetime, json). |
| `crud_path` | no | Optional and explicit: also add a `kind = "crud"` Route at this path (e.g. `/products`) when none serves the Dataset. Omit it to create or update the Dataset alone (no Route). |
| `generator` | no | Declarative generator seed (`{rows, fields:[{name, kind, ...}]}`); replaces any seed source. |
| `id_strategy` | no | `uuid` (default), `increment` or `ulid`. |
| `key` | no | Item identifier field (default `id`). |
| `name` | yes | Dataset name (letters, digits, `_`, `-`). |
| `persist` | no | Persist mutations under .fauxfield/state/. |
| `seed` | no | Seed rows as JSON text (an array, or an object for a singleton); written to data/<name>.json. |
| `seed_template` | no | Tera template rendering to JSON, written to files/<name>.json.tera (instead of `seed`). |
| `server` | yes | Server ID, name or file slug. |
| `validate` | no | JSON Schema file (workspace-relative) for POST/PUT/PATCH on the CRUD Route. |

### `upsert_route`

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `docs` | no | Markdown docs (the API documentation operation description); empty removes it. |
| `folder` | no | Folder ID (`fld_…`). |
| `headers` | no | Route headers (values are templated); set or replace by name. |
| `match` | no | Match mode: exact, param or regex; omit to keep (create: inferred). |
| `method` | no |  |
| `name` | no |  |
| `openapi` | no | API documentation overrides (`[routes.openapi]`); only the given keys change. |
| `path` | no |  |
| `pinned` | no | Keep this Route mocked when the proxy is in `passthrough` mode. |
| `priority` | no | Higher wins; 0 is the default and is not written. |
| `proxy` | no | Forward this Route to the proxy upstream even when other Routes are mocked. |
| `response_mode` | no | `rules` (default), `sequential`, `random` or `disabled`. |
| `responses` | no |  |
| `route` | no | Existing Route ID to update; omit to create. |
| `server` | yes | Server ID, name, or file slug. |

## Resources

| URI | Description |
|---|---|
| `fauxfield://schema/server` | JSON Schema of servers/<slug>.toml |
| `fauxfield://docs/templating` | Tera functions, filters and fake kinds available in Responses |
| `fauxfield://traffic/recent` | The last 100 Recordings, secrets redacted |
| `fauxfield://servers/{id}` | One Server as structured JSON; id is an ID, name or file slug |

## Prompts

| Prompt | Argument | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `mock_from_openapi` | `spec` | Mock the endpoints of an OpenAPI document and verify them. |
| `mock_from_description` | `description` | Create mock Routes from a plain-language description and verify them. |
| `mock_for_frontend_feature` | `feature` | Read the code of a frontend feature, mock every endpoint it calls and verify. |
